subject: Geografia
description_pt: Elaborar modelos tridimensionais, blocos-diagramas e perfis topográficos e de vegetação, visando à representação de elementos e estruturas da superfície terrestre.

components.description_pt: Construir modelos tridimensionais representando características da superfície terrestre
components.description_en: Construct three-dimensional models representing features of Earth's surface
components.cc_component_description: Construct a causal chain linking one Earth surface change to effects in multiple systems

components.description_pt: Elaborar blocos-diagramas para representar estruturas geológicas e de relevo
components.description_en: Build block diagrams to represent geological and relief structures
components.cc_component_description: Construct a model to represent the components and interactions within a system

components.description_pt: Construir perfis topográficos a partir de mapas de curvas de nível
components.description_en: Construct topographic profiles from contour-line maps
components.cc_component_description: Construct a graphical display such as a scatter plot or line graph from a data set

components.description_pt: Construir perfis de vegetação para representar a distribuição da cobertura vegetal sobre o relevo
components.description_en: Construct vegetation profiles to represent plant cover distribution across relief features

cc_matches.description: Analyze geoscience data to make the claim that one change to Earth's surface can create feedbacks that cause changes to other Earth systems.
Construct, analyze, and/or interpret graphical displays of data and/or large data sets to identify linear and nonlinear relationships.
